Type: round wall mirror with shelf
Use: reflecting light, holding small items; entryway, bedroom, living room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, coastal
Materials: distressed painted wood frame, natural wood inner edge, mirror glass
Colors: white, light natural wood, silver
Shape: circular deep frame with a low horizontal shelf across the bottom, clean outline, medium size
Feel: bright, soft, relaxed
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, rattan; farmhouse or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Mirror Wall Shelf, 24"H, White
product.description: Made from fir wood with a distressed white finish, this circular mirrored wall shelf is a perfect accent for rustic décor. The mirror reflects the beautiful natural grain of the wood’s inside rim, and the shelf is just the right size for displaying small treasures. 24"H x 24"W x 4"D Fir wood with MDF and mirror This mirror shelf's distressed white finish works well with a variety of home-décor themes, including modern simple and vintage. No hanging materials needed
